editedExercise.name: Bent Knee Toe Touches

instructions.description: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides. Lift your legs so your knees are bent at approximately 90°, with your calves parallel to the floor.
Gently engage your core and lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor. Keep your lower back in a comfortable, stable position.
Reach your right hand toward your right foot, then return to center and reach your left hand toward your left foot. Alternate sides in a controlled movement.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions, keeping your core engaged and avoiding momentum or excessive pulling with your neck.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count repetitions completed with controlled technique.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Instead of lifting your shoulders, keep your upper body relaxed on the floor and slowly lower one foot toward the floor at a time. This provides a gentler core exercise while still challenging abdominal control.

commentsNotes: Keep your knees bent at approximately 90° throughout the exercise.
Lift through your upper abdominals rather than pulling your head or neck forward.
Keep the movement controlled and focus on reaching toward the foot rather than simply moving the arm.
Avoid excessive arching of the lower back; gently engage your core to keep your pelvis stable.
Exhale as you reach toward the foot and inhale as you return to center.
